One of Craig's post yesterday gave me an idea so here it goes.

BREAKING NEWS: Calling all Sentinels. Calling all Sentinels. La Captain is up to her old tricks again. She and her crew have just kidnapped Christopher and sailed off with him. She is currently using her ship to teleport between different environments. We only have a few short days to go to all the enviornments, defeat her, and bring back Christopher (sidenote: especially if Craig can give us an idea whien the geek migration will be over to have an end date to this challenge). If we fail it will mean the end of the Multiverse as we know it.

Your mission. Defeat La Captain in different enviroments as a community. When you defeat her somewhere come here and post which team and what enviorment (no fan made) you use and this announcement will keep track (we will use the honor system). When we defeat her in all she will no longer be able to hold Christopher hostage and will let him go and the Multiverse will continue in all its awesomeness. Defeat her multiple times in the same place to send her a message, that we love Christopther and want to bring him back. Plus with his rescue maybe Christopher will announce something special for preorders that he wasnt planning on before.......... (this is me just hoping)

Go to it Sentinels!!!!!!

posts.name: Estelindis
posts.cooked:
A team consisting of Legacy, Parse, Omnitron-X and the Visionary valiantly defeated La Capitan in the Realm of Discord. :)

Things were a bit shaky at first, with La Capitan quickly and easily undoing all the heroes' preparations.  Once they got back on their feet, though, they focused on damaging her ship and stopping certain crew members from appearing.  The foresight of Visionary and the analytical powers of Parse helped a great deal with this.  A positive energy field appeared immediately after the last of a group of crew members had been dispatched, meaning that only the heroes benefitted from it.  When a negative energy field replaced it, Legacy heroically prevented it from damaging anyone but La Capitan.  The heroes exploited the effects of the field, moving and acting as much as possible in order to increase its effects on the time-travelling pirate captain.  Before long, a rocket punch from Omnitron-X had sent her hurling back into the mists of time, but not before Christopher was saved from being forced to walk the plank.  :)

A very fun game.  Although two hero ongoing/equipment cards were destroyed by villains at the start of the second round, no other destruction of this kind happened, so she never flipped.  Six rounds, no incaps.  Lowest health a hero ever hit was 16hp (Legacy).

posts.cooked:
As Chrono Ranger materialized in the streets of Rook City, he was surprised to see that Visionary was waiting for him - and had gained the help of Ra and Expatriette !

"You are hunting the pirate. She kidnapped a man I am indebted to - I'll help. Oh, and you're late."

so : Expatriette, Ra, Visionary, Chrono-Ranger, in Rook City.

Chrono Ranger fell fast under the constant assaults of Battle Forged, and the team walked the plank many times, but they finally reached victory ina last minute "All Hell Loose" attack - thanks to the moral support of Jim and lot of luck (they would have lost on next turn).

Rook city : heroes 1, capitan 0.

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
I want to help!

 

Woof. This was hard. Pike Industrial, La Capitan, Chrono Ranger, Parse, Sentinels. We won! But, everyone died at least once, and we stood victorious with just Maintstay and Idealist active, 1 HP each. Both Chrono and Parse were taken out by double Cold Vats with their damage changed to Toxic and increased by 1. The Sentinels managed to avoid this (for two turns) thanks to Mainstay's damage reduction power and Human Shield.

Also, I just noticed that Human Shield can be used for damage dealt to ALL Hero targets, not just the Sentinels. That...that would have made this much easier. Damn.

Anyway, the Cold Vats ate away a great amount of La Capitan while Chrono allowed Mainstay and Friend(s) to play a card to pile on more damage and Parse (put the Magnifica on the bottom of La Capitan's deck and then did nothing, golly gee) drew them a card and Mainstay proper kept on protecting! It was great?

To make a long story short (too late), when she finally toppled over, Siege Breaker dropped off a sign reading, 'Your designer is in another castle.'

Scratch another one off the list, friends!
